Condition : 2 - :
The permission hereby granted shall be for a limited period expiring on 4 August 2007 when the use shall cease and the marquees shall be removed within one week of that date.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the Marquee is used.
Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted for the Marquee shall not be carried on outside the following times 10am to 11.30pm on all days except Sundays when events will end at 11pm.

Condition : 5 - Within one month of the date of this permission, a scheme of work including a timetable and a detailed method statement shall be submitted to the local planning authority for approval detailing how, on or before 31 August 2007, the site of the Marquees and parking areas hereby permitted are to be reinstated to their former condition and the works shall then be carried out in accordance with the details so approved.
Condition : 6 - No  excavations shall take place for the construction of, or for the purposes of the use of the marquee.

Condition : 7 - For the duration of any event to be held in the marquees, the organisers shall take measures to ensure that visitors or staff cars associated with the use parked in no place other than Lime Avenue or the main public car park on the site and the designated disabled persons' parking spaces shown on the plans hereby approved and shall ensure that these car parking areas are shown in the submitted application are available exclusively to visitors and staff at the event.
Condition : 8 - Music noise emanating from this premises between 23.00 and 07.00 shall be inaudible at the fa?ade of the nearest residential property.
Condition : 9 - No firework displays shall take place in conjunction with any event held in or adjoining the Marquees hereby approved.

Condition : 10 - For the duration of any event to be held in the marquees, the organisers shall take measures to ensure that visitors or staff do not enter the area of the nearby Site of Special Scientific Interest..

Condition : 11 - The applicant shall supply the local planning authority, no later than 16 June 2007, with a list of functions planned for the month of July 2007 including anticipated numbers of guests, times and dates..
description: Erection of temporary marquee for daytime and evening private corporate events from 7th April to 4th August 2007
